notes: Formerly Cisco DNA Center. Primary intent-based networking controller for Catalyst infrastructure. Manages switches, routers, WLC. Also available as cloud SaaS.

use_case: Network Access Control (NAC) / Policy / AAA / Zero Trust
notes: 802.1X, TACACS+, RADIUS, device profiling, guest access, posture. Can be deployed on Cisco SNS appliances or as VMs.

use_case: Multi-vendor Network Automation / Orchestration / Service Provisioning
notes: Model-driven orchestration using YANG/NETCONF. Used widely in SP and enterprise for automated provisioning. Runs on Linux VMs.

use_case: SP / DC WAN Traffic Engineering and Segment Routing Automation
notes: Automates SR-TE and RSVP-TE path computation and provisioning. Tightly integrated with IOS-XR platforms.

use_case: SP WAN Traffic Optimization / Bandwidth Management
notes: WAN bandwidth and traffic optimization using SR-TE. Often deployed alongside Crosswork Network Controller.

use_case: Internet / SaaS / WAN Visibility and Network Intelligence
notes: Cloud-based monitoring platform. Agents deployed on endpoints, routers, cloud VMs. Acquired by Cisco 2020. Integrates with Catalyst Center.

use_case: Network Traffic Analysis / NDR / Threat Detection
notes: Formerly Stealthwatch. NetFlow-based NDR. Deployed as on-prem VM or appliance. Also available as SaaS (Secure Network Analytics Cloud).

use_case: Remote Access VPN / Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) / Endpoint Security
notes: Formerly AnyConnect. Client software for Windows/macOS/Linux/iOS/Android. VPN + ZTNA + Secure Firewall posture + Umbrella + ThousandEyes modules.

use_case: DNS-layer Security / Cloud-delivered Secure Web Gateway / CASB / ZTNA
notes: Cloud-delivered DNS security and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE). Protects users on and off network. Recursive DNS with threat intelligence.
Cloud-delivered MFA and device trust. Integrates with VPN, web apps, on-prem apps. Acquired by Cisco 2018.

use_case: Hybrid Cloud / Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) / UCS Management
notes: Cisco's cloud-based infrastructure management for UCS, HyperFlex, and third-party compute. Replaces UCS Director for modern deployments.

notes: Formerly Cisco Tetration. Micro-segmentation and workload protection for DC/cloud apps. Deployed on-prem (dedicated hardware cluster) or SaaS.
APM platform acquired by Cisco 2017. Monitors application transactions, code-level diagnostics, business impact. Part of Cisco Full-Stack Observability.

use_case: Centralized SD-WAN Management and Policy Controller
notes: Central management plane for Catalyst SD-WAN (formerly Viptela). Manages both vEdge and cEdge devices. Also available cloud-hosted.
